name: superimg
description: Programmatic video generation — HTML/CSS templates in *.media.ts rendered to MP4. Teaches Codex the SuperImg define() API.

interface.longDescription: SuperImg renders TypeScript scene definitions into video files. This plugin gives Codex the framework's mental model (std.score, std.cue, render(ctx) contracts) for building and editing templates.
defaultPrompt: Create a SuperImg template that announces a launch
